title: Areas of the system
summary: Every planet and moon you can land on is split into areas. Pick one as a skirmish's site; Domination, coming later, is a war for all of them.
text:
The solar system is split into **40 areas**: Home has 7, Verdance 6, Rime 5, Dunmore 4, and the smaller worlds, moons and the asteroid Talus between 1 and 3. Gas giants and comets have none. Each area has a name from where it lies and what its ground is like (**Northern Highlands**, **Eastern Dry Basin**), and on a world with seas it's always on land. Touchdown, where the campaign lands, is Home's first.

**Playing on an area.** In the **SKIRMISH** setup, **Site** lists the areas of the world you pick (or **Anywhere** for a random spot). The moons and Talus are worlds you can pick too. A battle on an area is fought on that very place: the same ground every time you go there.

**Seeing them.** In a battle on an area, zoom out to the planet: borders split the world into its areas, each with its name, and yours is tinted and marked *you are here*. Further out, in the system view, every world's label says how many areas it has, and close to a world its areas show as dots.

Areas next to each other on the same world are linked overland. **Domination**, a long war for the whole system, is coming: you'll take areas one by one and win by wiping out the other players.
